title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.178.0
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: SDKs: unified auth+retries API across Python/TS/Go; improved streaming ergonomics; parity fixes; bumped SDK versions to v1.178.0. See CHANGELOGs for per-language details.
description: Motivation: We maintain three SDKs (python/typescript/go) and have drift between auth initialization, retry/backoff defaults, and streaming ergonomics. This PR unifies behaviors, fixes several parity bugs, and bumps versions to v1.178.0. Summary of changes: 1) Centralized auth loader behavior so token refresh / KMS-backed keys behave the same across SDKs; 2) Standardized retry policy + backoff defaults (exponential with jitter, max_attempts=4) and exposed a single RetryConfig type; 3) Streaming API ergonomics: Python async generator + sync iterator helpers, TS async iterator + onData callbacks, Go context-cancelled stream wrappers with proper Close semantics; 4) Parity fixes: consistent chunked response handling, consistent error types/structures, aligned telemetry labels for SDK-origin; 5) Tests & docs: new e2e coverage, updated quickstarts and changelogs. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth init and refresh logic across SDKs - [x] Implement shared RetryConfig and use it in HTTP client wrappers - [x] Add streaming ergonomics helpers per-language - [x] Add unit + integration tests for retry/backoff and streaming - [x] Update docs, examples, and CHANGELOGs - [x] Bump package versions to v1.178.0 and update release metadata Compatibility notes: Default retry/backoff values changed to be slightly more conservative to reduce tail-retries under high load (max_attempts decreased from 6 to 4). This is backward-compatible for almost all users but noted in release notes. Customer-facing behavior for auth should be identical unless custom auth hooks relied on previous internal init order; guidance noted in SDK migration docs. Testing performed: Local unit tests (python/ts/go) and CI runs against redwood staging: - Python: added tests for token refresh during long-lived streams - TS: added tests for stream backpressure + callback consistency - Go: added tests for context cancellation and stream Close semantics - End-to-end smoke tests against staging API to validate headers/telemetry and backoff behavior Observability: SDKs now emit standardized sdk.version and sdk.language labels on telemetry spans and metrics. Rollout: Gradual release; published packages for Python/TS/Go to internal package feeds. If issues discovered we will cut a targeted patch (v1.178.1). Links: Linear ENG-17821, docs PR in redwood-docs (linked in notes).

impact_summary: Operational: minor change to default retry attempts (6->4) likely reduces backend retries at cost of one less attempt; recommended for production. Developer: new top-level RetryConfig and streaming helpers simplify integration and reduce common boilerplate.
migration_steps: Python: upgrade to >=1.178.0 and replace AuthClient init with UnifiedAuthLoader if custom hooks are used
TS: upgrade package and optionally import RetryConfig from top-level package to customize backoff
Go: upgrade and use StreamWrapper.Close(ctx) to ensure proper cancellation semantics
